summary: VistaOne, L.P. filed an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of limited partnership units in its continuous private offering, raising approximately $42.2 million from third-party investors across four classes, priced at transactional NAV per unit disclosed as of June 30, 2026. The filing also discloses a related-party transaction involving the transfer of SambaNova Systems preferred stock from a Vista affiliate to the fund, subject to investment committee approval. This is routine fund operational reporting, not a special situation; no change of control, tender, or strategic event is involved.
